The '''Vorpal Katana''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 5}}. It is the upgraded form of the {{Item|Voidedge Katana}}.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Vorpal Katana'''{{'}}s name references the 1871 nonsense poem "[[w:Jabberwocky|Jabberwocky]]" by Lewis Carroll, in which a character uses a "vorpal" sword (a made-up adjective) to slay a powerful beast.
** The word "vorpal" is onomatopoeic for the sounds Endermen make, which is likely why this name was chosen, as it is an end-themed weapon.
